info.title: Qadam Business API
info.description: Authenticated manual ledger and optional Gemini drafts. AI never writes money. Public catalog and private seller inquiries.

get.description: Without ids: existing search and cursor pagination. With repeated query ids (ids=UUID&ids=UUID): 1-100 values before deduplication, first-occurrence order, only customers in the accessible business. Missing/foreign IDs are omitted equally. Explicit q, cursor or limit with ids returns 422. The complete result uses the same Page and server-calculated balances, with next_cursor=null; no default limit truncation.

parameters.name: ids

schema.description: Repeat ids once per UUID (form/explode). Empty values or >100 entries return 422; duplicates count toward the limit and are returned once. Do not combine with q, cursor or limit, even their default/empty values.
schema.title: Ids

parameters.description: Repeat ids once per UUID (form/explode). Empty values or >100 entries return 422; duplicates count toward the limit and are returned once. Do not combine with q, cursor or limit, even their default/empty values.

post.description: Optional Idempotency-Key scopes a durable creation to this user and business. Replay returns the original 201 snapshot; changed validated body returns 409. Without the key, each request creates a new customer (legacy behavior).

get.description: Recover this user's committed customer creation using Idempotency-Key. not_observed does not rule out an in-flight or delayed request. No automatic expiry.

schema.title: Response Get Customer Creation Result Api V1 Businesses  Id  Customer Creation Result Get
Response Get Operations Api V1 Businesses  Id  Operations Get

post.description: RU/KK text or audio → draft. No monetary write. Confirm via POST operations. Exactly one source; 30-minute expiry, author and business scoped, single use. AI failure leaves manual input available. Audio is decoded to WAV in memory.

Seller question → short answer from server-calculated facts of this business. The model only words the answer; every amount, count and customer is checked against facts, otherwise source=fallback with a server template. No ledger writes, nothing is sent: reminder_draft is text to copy. ai=false returns source=facts: the server summary of the same facts without a model call or daily limit, for automatic page loads. Disabled deployments return 404 ASSISTANT_DISABLED; a per-user daily limit returns 429 ASSISTANT_LIMIT.
